decisions.summary: Two data files: source-tags.json (ordered value lists + canon label) and source-sections.json (ordered sections, clauses over PRIMARY tags, works- id prefix)
decisions.why: Carries FR-001, FR-006 (rule over primary tags, first match, regrouping by editing one file).

decisions.summary: Tags as a last-line HTML comment marker; canon carries none; every malformed case gathered into the build's error list
decisions.why: FR-005 (grep-findable, never shown raw) and FR-010; the extra refusals (repeated facet, marker on canon) only enforce FR-004.

decisions.summary: Period cut-offs stated for every region value: Japan, China, Korea, Other East Asia (Vietnam, Ryukyu, Taiwan by colonial rule or annexation), Europe (before ~1800 / ~1800-1950 / after ~1950), Elsewhere (by railways, factory goods or colonial cash cropping; ~1950), General (the rule of its evidence's region, or not period-bound); every cell written into the period explanations in source-tags.json; an unsettled source is listed for the session, never judged in a batch note
decisions.why: Round 1's item resolved: GM message 2 delegates the cut-offs on the condition that the logic is explained in the tooltips, and FR-003 requires each to be set by region and stated in the period explanation. Every region value now has a cut-off or a stated rule, all of it is placed in the tooltips, and no cut-off reasoning is left to batch notes no reader sees.

decisions.summary: FR-007's eight sections in order; Not period-bound (before the last) takes primary timeless works of any region
decisions.why: FR-007 order plus FR-006 first-match; the last section's 'whatever its period' clause still guarantees every combination a home.

decisions.summary: Labels as spans with data-def + title under each work heading, period/region/kind order; grouped h3 sections with descriptions on question foot, all.html registry part and sources/index.html; registry pager walks grouped order; marker stripped
decisions.why: FR-008, FR-009 (existing #fntip tooltip, native title without scripts), US2 scenarios 1-3.

decisions.summary: New engine module record/source_tags.py (loaders, parse, home, labels_html, strip_marker, Catalog); registry_entries gains raw tags
decisions.why: Implementation structure for FR-006..FR-010; no scope change.

decisions.summary: make reserve KIND=registry TAGS=...; checked against vocabulary; placeholder marker without TAGS that the build refuses
source-applicability contract gains a Tags rule, a derived vocabulary block kept in sync by make source-tags-contract and a failing test, and a tags verdict line
decisions.why: FR-012 (contract judges tags and repeated limits, carries the explanations); the sync test only enforces FR-012.

decisions.summary: Docs: research CLAUDE.md, research doctrine, page-session rules, plus one clause in the root CLAUDE.md
decisions.why: FR-013; the root clause is a pointer serving the same rule, not new behavior.

decisions.summary: Spec-local migration tooling: Sonnet batches classify and propose trims; apply.py checks vocabulary, R4 and R3 consistency lists; refusals and flags worked by hand; build check and data land in one push
decisions.why: FR-014, FR-015; refused trims go to the session, so the scope of the trim is not reduced.

decisions.summary: Stratified sample of at least 60 entries (>=5 per period and region value where they exist) via check bundles to source-applicability; every wrong tag and repeated or lost limit fixed; patterns swept by grep
URL host used only as a hint and a consistency check for kind; every entry classified by reading
source-applicability sampled at 60 entries instead of run on every trimmed write-up; mechanical R4 checks stand in for the rest
decisions.why: The GM's request is silent on how the migration is verified, and the accepted spec settles it explicitly (SC-004, SC-005: a stratified sample of at least 60, plus a registry-wide sweep of any pattern). It narrows a standing project rule, not the GM's request or the spec; the plan records it as an accepted limitation with costs, priced alternatives and who chose, as CLAUDE.md requires. R4 rule 2 guarantees the trim adds no claim or number that would need an applicability judgment.

decisions.summary: Mechanical trim acceptance: not longer, no new words beyond connectives, inline markup and HTML comments kept, reason-for-applying kept; else listed for hand work; null = no trim
decisions.why: Stricter than FR-015's 'gains nothing new' and refusals are done by hand, so every paragraph is still owed its trim; lost source-specific limits are SC-005's sample and sweep.

decisions.summary: Classification rules: period by evidence, present-day sites describing premodern forms, not period-bound for physical facts, region placement, kind definitions, canon untagged
decisions.why: Restates the spec's edge cases and FR-004; the cut-off clause now points at plan D3's table and routes unsettled sources to the session, so it carries no narrowing.

decisions.summary: Marker placed on the last line rather than under the heading or as an h3 attribute
decisions.why: FR-005; placement is design, not scope.

decisions.summary: make record timed before and after; >10% slowdown diagnosed before landing
